diagnosis: Loopback TX stayed idle so ser_tx=1 and RX got 0xff vs want 0xa5 at TRAP: uart data mismatch got 0xff want 0xa5. With divider 64 from picosoc/picosoc.v:120 and picosoc/picosoc.v:197 reg_div_we path, TX bit timer at picosoc/simpleuart.v:130 uses (cfg_divider >> 4) making TX ~16x too fast, so the RX sampler misses the start/data bits and reads idle. Fix is to use full cfg_divider for the TX bit period.
expected: tohost PASS, no TRAP, uart loopback 0xa5 received correctly
